firstPlayerRule: Place the players’ tokens on the Turn Order Chart randomly during setup. When the first productive season begins, everyone rolls their dice; the lowest total takes the first advisor-influence turn, followed by the other totals in ascending order.
officialTieBreak: If dice totals are equal, retain their relative order from the previous season, or from the random setup order in the first season.
clarifications: The first phase is Aid from the King. In the first year, all players receive one good because they are tied; the first advisor choices come afterward.
